summary: The Last of Us entries from Sami's spine and sourced supplemental seeds, built for per-platform route research.

entries.title: The Last of Us
entries.definitive_edition: The Last of Us Part I on Windows PC + PS4 Remastered for Factions only

emulation.emulator: Native PC primary; PS4 hardware for secondary
emulation.notes: Use native Windows Part I for the campaign/Left Behind; use PS4 Remastered only for Factions multiplayer if access is still available.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Highest for story on Windows Part I; completeness requires the PS4 Remastered multiplayer mode as a separate secondary route.

primary.version: The Last of Us Part I on Windows PC
primary.why: The Part I remake is the highest-fidelity story route and includes the Left Behind expansion; the Windows version adds PC display/settings flexibility. It is not fully content-complete against the original release family because the original/Remastered Factions multiplayer mode is omitted from Part I, so PS4 Remastered is kept as a secondary route for that mode only.
primary.how_to_play: Play The Last of Us Part I on Windows with current patches, shader compilation complete, and official settings guidance; use PS4 Remastered only if you specifically want to sample Factions multiplayer and current online access permits it.

secondary.exclusive_content: Factions online multiplayer mode from the original/Remastered release family, omitted from The Last of Us Part I.
secondary.what_to_play: Play only the Factions multiplayer modes if current server/community access permits; do not replay the story campaign here unless doing historical comparison.
secondary.why: The original/Remastered version includes multiplayer/Factions, while the online multiplayer mode is omitted from the Part I remake.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PS3 release with Factions multiplayer, but lowest fidelity route for the story campaign.
all_releases.reason: skip: historical original; PS4 Remastered is the better secondary route for Factions, while PC Part I is the primary story route.

all_releases.fidelity: Remastered console release with Factions multiplayer and higher fidelity than PS3.
all_releases.reason: secondary: use only for Factions multiplayer because Part I omits the original online mode.

all_releases.fidelity: Modern remake route on PS5; excellent single-player fidelity but less configurable than PC.
all_releases.reason: skip: strong remake route, but Windows is the higher-fidelity capture route and PS5 also lacks Factions.

all_releases.fidelity: Modern remake with PC graphics/settings support and the highest capture ceiling.
all_releases.reason: primary: best story/Left Behind route for fidelity; pair with PS4 Remastered only for omitted Factions mode.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The highest-fidelity Part I remake route omits the original online Factions multiplayer mode; use Windows Part I for story/Left Behind and PS4 Remastered only for Factions if available.

entries.remaster_caveats: Part I is a remake with improved visuals/accessibility and Left Behind, but it omits the original online multiplayer mode. PC launch performance had issues, so use the current patched build and verify shader/performance behavior before capture.

entries.title: The Last of Us: Part II
entries.definitive_edition: The Last of Us Part II Remastered on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native Windows Remastered release with current patches and official settings guidance.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Highest: Windows Remastered settings/capture flexibility with the modern content package.

primary.version: The Last of Us Part II Remastered on Windows PC
primary.why: The Remastered package adds the modern feature set, including No Return and Lost Levels, and the Windows release gives the highest settings/capture ceiling. The PS4 original is superseded for completeness by Remastered, and no platform-exclusive story content is cited outside the PC/PS5 remaster package.
primary.how_to_play: Play The Last of Us Part II Remastered on Windows with current patches, owned/installed content, and official settings guidance; verify No Return and Lost Levels are present before capture.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PS4 release; lower fidelity and lacks the Remastered package additions.
all_releases.reason: skip: superseded for this archive by the Remastered routes with No Return/Lost Levels.

all_releases.fidelity: Modern remaster package with No Return, Lost Levels, and PS5 improvements.
all_releases.reason: skip: strong complete console route, but Windows has the higher settings/capture ceiling.

all_releases.fidelity: PC release of the Remastered package with the highest capture/settings flexibility and new No Return content.
all_releases.reason: primary: best-fidelity complete package route for the current archive.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced platform-exclusive story or mode content is missing from the Windows Remastered route in this pass.

entries.remaster_caveats: The PS4 original is historically important but lacks the Remastered package additions such as No Return and Lost Levels; use the current PC Remastered build for the full modern package.
